arrivalNote: XZ distance from the slot at the first arrived sample to targetWorld. Flag-on ends 16 cm from the target; flag-off lands within 1 cm.

bars.heelMissMedian: heel miss median < 0.01 m with flag on
bars.walkSlide: walk per-contact slide median reduced >= 0.01 m AND max reduced >= 0.02 m

capture.phases: walking -> settling -> arrived (28/47/32 frames both runs)

code: No default changed; ccdStanceLockEnabled default off. Runtime change is a read-only diagnostic tap (stanceLockHeelMissM); capture and metric changes are tools-only. No new package export, no admission overlay needed.
flagEngagement: The on-run is not a silent fallback: the deterministic sim diverges from the first stance frames, heel-miss median shifts 0.0617 -> 0.0258 m, and walk contact median shifts 0.1207 -> 0.0050 m. An ignored flag would leave bit-identical tracks.
metricValidation: Settling-phase contact episodes reproduce computeTurnQuality plantedSlideM exactly on the same capture (metricValidationDeltaM 0.00000 off and on). The per-contact machinery is validated; the walk numbers are usable.
onAnomaly: Flag-on max toe step 0.3425 m is a single-frame 0.34 m jump of the stance-labelled left foot at sample 21 (off: 0.086 m same frame) — a solve snap, not a stride. Flag-on arrival error 0.161 m vs 0.008 m off.
reason: 1/4 bars pass. Walk slide improves (median -0.1157 m, max -0.0532 m) but heel miss median stays above the bar (0.0258 m), max toe step regresses by 0.206 m on a stance-foot snap, and arrival regresses by 0.153 m. Keep the flag off.
toeStepNote: Both runs' sub-0.11 m steps are healthy swing motion. The on-run max is the sample-21 stance snap; the off-run max is an early-walk transient.
walkNote: Per-contact episodes (n=4 both runs) replace the maximal-run max. Flag-on pins the mid-walk contact well (median 5 mm) but leaves a 0.46 m max contact and snaps 0.34 m at the replant.
